text: My main symptom is Intermittent bleeding from the vagina. I also have No recent weight loss, No fever, No changes in bladder or bowel habits. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Pyelonephritis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia (secondary to Estrogen-secreting Ovarian Cyst).

The mention of pyelonephritis is likely a misunderstanding or error by the previous provider, as your symptoms of postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass are classic signs of a gynecological issue, specifically an estrogen-producing tumor like a granulosa cell tumor or a complex cyst causing endometrial thickening. The ultrasound results will confirm whether the mass is cystic or solid and if the endometrium is thickened. Do you have any history of irregular bleeding in the past, or did this start suddenly after years of being completely postmenopausal?
